scripts._comment:build: NODE_OPTIONS raises V8's OLD-SPACE CEILING from its ~4GB default to 6GB. The codebase outgrew the default on 2026-07-22: `next build` died with 'Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit' (exit 134, Abort trap 6) on a 48GB Mac with 73% of RAM free — so it was never a machine limit, it was Node capping itself. Because the pre-push gate builds before every push, that failure BLOCKED ALL PUSHES on that machine, with an error (a wall of hex + 'Abort trap') that looks nothing like 'you need more heap'. This is a CEILING, not a reservation: a build that already fits under 4GB allocates exactly as much as before, so Vercel is unaffected (its builds pass at the default today, i.e. they peak below 4GB). 6144 was chosen by measurement — the build OOMs at the 4GB default and completes at 6GB — and it leaves headroom under an 8GB Vercel Pro build container. If this ever OOMs again, MEASURE the new peak before raising it; do not reflexively double it.
scripts._comment:check:db-constraints: Deprecated alias of check:db-contract. A git worktree runs the MAIN checkout's pre-push hook against the WORKTREE's package.json, and other machines pull the new hook and the new package.json at slightly different moments. Renaming the script without keeping the old name would make the gate crash — and a gate that crashes gets bypassed with --no-verify, which is how gates die. Keep until every checkout carries the renamed hook.
